technical_overview: Offered at $19.0 for 8ml, this KoColor Fashion MASCARA is expertly formulated with Isododecane, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Iron Oxides. Delivering a high-fidelity Midnight Black color profile (`#000000`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers.
